title: RedHen Labs automation rule
description: Shape of an automation in RedHen Labs. Conditions are evaluated over a lookback window; entities satisfying ALL conditions receive the action. Actions are proposals unless auto_apply is true.

auto_apply.description: false = propose and wait for approval. true = act unattended (Professional plan; enabled deliberately per automation).

max_bid.description: Ceiling the automation may never exceed. The primary safety property.

lookback_days.description: Metrics are SUMMED over this window, not averaged. A longer window makes any threshold easier to trip.

negative_level.description: Negative keywords support both. Negative PRODUCT targets are ad-group only on Amazon.

add_negative_to_source.description: Harvest only. Add the harvested term as a negative exact in the source campaign. A deliberate choice, not a rule — see docs/negative-keywords.md. The engine will not negate into a campaign that is also a destination.

windows.description: Dayparting only. Reconciled continuously, not fired as a schedule; the original bid is restored when a window closes.

explanation.description: Human/LLM-readable statement of the decision this rule encodes.
